items.html: You will also understand what is written, that when they were face-to-face, two phases of Yaakov come out, one in ZA and one in the Nukva. It is so because the one that is from the Mochin of ZA is from AVI, and the other, which is from the ­Mochin of the Nukva, is from Israel Saba veTvuna. At that time, they are the two great Lights, she is not greater than him, and he is not greater than her, and they do not need each other at all. Nevertheless, the posterior of Abba is on the right side, in Hesed of ZA, and the posterior of Ima are on the left side, in Gevura of ZA, and this study will be addressed in its place.
